searchText: 1559 is released when? And Berlin is released when? Sorry for noob question guys I couldnt find it anywhere else. If any devs need work, I could help Berlin is targeting March, but no official fork block yet. 1559 is targeting sometim after that. thanks, how much after that? Within a month or 2 or many months/year Crypto hedge fund Tyr Capital Arbitrage SP conducted a refutation of JPMorgan’s claim that a bitcoin ETF would hurt the price in the short-term. Unknown exactly. Maybe 4-9 months based on history? Maybe less if we can move things faster than usual? The likeliest timeline, if it happens "soon" is July-ish, becuase we need to push back the difficulty bomb around then. That's the next "open spot" after Berlin
